theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have key (A : Set S) : A ∈ P ↔ Aᶜ ∉ P := by grind
  have himg : P.image (fun A : Set S => Aᶜ) = Finset.univ \ P := by
    ext A
    simp only [Finset.mem_image, Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_univ, true_and]
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨B, hB, rfl⟩
      exact key B |>.mp hB
    · exact fun h => ⟨Aᶜ, (key Aᶜ).mpr (by simpa using h), compl_compl A⟩
  have hsum := Finset.card_sdiff_add_card_eq_card (Finset.subset_univ P)
  rw [← himg, Finset.card_image_of_injective P compl_injective, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set,
    ← two_mul] at hsum
  have h2p : 2 ^ Fintype.card S = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 := by
    rw [← pow_succ, Nat.sub_add_cancel (Nat.succ_le_of_lt Fintype.card_pos)]
  omega
